name: Aak
description: Continually loses HP over time
usage: Aak, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will support other Operators from the rear.

name: Angelina
description: Deals Arts damage and Slows the target for a short time
usage: Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, would like to provide help with her amazing Originium Arts.

name: Archetto
description: Attacks aerial enemies first
usage: Cleric of Landen Monastery Archetto, the power to rebuild faith stronger than faith itself.

name: Ascalon
description: Deals Damage to all targets within range 50% chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks and is less likely to be targeted by enemies
usage: S.W.E.E.P. Supervisor Ascalon—the fog of the war, the smoke of the fire, the one who pounces when the time is right.

name: Ash
description: Attacks aerial enemies first
usage: Ash, a member of Team Rainbow, always has grenades loaded and ready.

name: Astgenne the Lightchaser
description: Deals Arts damage and Slows the target for a short time
usage: Elena Urbica, PhD, is a researcher from Rhine Lab's Energy Section, and currently their team leader at the Kjerag Observation Station. One of the primary investigators of the Kjerag Catastrophe.

name: Bagpipe
description: Obtain 1 DP after this unit defeats an enemy; Refunds the original DP Cost when retreated
usage: Bagpipe, former Victorian soldier, has come in search of the truth.

name: Bellone
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: The current Don of Siracusa's Bellone Family. Through Vigil's introduction, he has entered into a partnership with Rhodes Island on behalf of the Family to exchange information and conduct trade.

name: Blaze
description: Attacks all blocked enemies
usage: Blaze, Rhodes Island's most fired-up Operator, will spread her enthusiasm like a wildfire.

name: Blaze the Igniting Spark
description: Attacks deal Arts damage, and can inflict Elemental Damage
usage: Gu Zhuhuang, code name Blaze, is an elite operator who wields powerful, destructive Arts over a wide area. Able to handle both Guard and Caster roles, she plays a key tactical role in various combat operations, from assault to defense to raids.

name: Blemishine
description: Can heal allies by using skill(s)
usage: Blemishine, Kazimierz knight, is the light of glory about to bloom.

name: Carnelian
description: Normally does not attack, but has greatly increased DEF and RES; When skill is active, attacks deal AoE Arts damage
usage: Caster Operator Carnelian, mature and calm, yet partial to some havoc now and then.

name: Ceobe
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Ceobe is always ready to go after the bad guys.

name: Ch'en
description: Normal attacks deal damage twice
usage: Ch'en, Special Inspection Unit Chief, L.G.D., is cooperating with Rhodes Island to fulfill the obligations outlined in her contract.

name: Ch'en the Dawnstreak
description: Deals Arts damage
usage:
Ch'en, former Lungmen superintendent and former head of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Victorian Royal Guard Academy with superb marks and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals.
Having resigned from the L.G.D., she is now officially a member of Rhodes Island. In accordance with her wishes, she is mainly assigned to provide field operators adequate support and on-location guidance.
She continues to fight on the frontlines as a Rhodes Island Operator.

name: Ch'en the Holungday
description: Attacks all enemies within range, and deals 150% damage to enemies in the row directly in front of this unit.
usage: Rhodes Island Operator Ch'en, back from vacation.

name: Chongyue
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: Chongyue, self-proclaimed simple warrior visiting from Yan. (But no one's ever seen him in true action)

name: Civilight Eterna
description: Does not attack but continuously restores the HP of all allies within range (the HP restored per second is equal to 10% of self ATK). Self is unaffected by Inspiration
usage: Babel's founder, Theresa.

name: Closure
description: This unit can designate one Tactical Point within attack range to call Reinforcements; ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements
usage:
Closure, Rhodes Island's Chief Engineer, head of the Procurement Department, and concurrent overseer of several other departments' affairs.

I'll be waiting for everyone at Procurement. If you want to get to know me, do you really need to read my file?
—Closure

name: Crownslayer
description: Significantly reduced Redeployment Time
usage: Lyudmila Ilyinichna, a former Reunion squad leader who dealt in covert operations and assassinations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. She parted with Reunion in the wake of the Chernobog-Lungmen Incident, and approached Rhodes Island at the end of 1100. She is currently receiving Oripathy treatment while under supervision.

name: Degenbrecher
description: Normal attacks deal damage twice
usage: Guard Operator Degenbrecher, forever stood behind you.

name: Dorothy
description: Can use traps to assist in combat, but traps cannot be placed on tiles already occupied by an enemy
usage: Dorothy, Rhine Lab Collaborating Operator. Brave enough, and always facing forward.

name: Dusk
description: Deals AOE Arts damage
usage: Coming on a whim, the great painter, Dusk, puts only the finishing touches on all jobs.

name: Ebenholz
description: Attacks deal Arts damage; When unable to find a target, attacks can be stored up and fired all at once (Up to 3 charges)
usage: Caster Operator Ebenholz refuses to add any unnecessary prefixes in front of his name.

name: Ela
description: Can use traps to assist in combat, but traps cannot be placed on tiles already occupied by an enemy
usage: Team Rainbow member Ela has a surprise for you with her Grzmot mines.

name: Entelechia
description: Cannot be healed by allies; Attacks deal AoE damage; Recovers 50 HP for every enemy hit during attacks, up to Block count
usage:
A member of the Kazdelian intelligence organization Rose Riverside, Entelechia has previously supplied information to Babel. She made contact with Rhodes Island during the Londinium War, and is currently on the landship as a guest.
Please note that no formal contract exists between Entelechia and Rhodes Island. All cooperation with her is to be considered private commissions.

name: Eunectes
description: Only restores SP when blocking enemies
usage: Eunectes, Gavial's rival, steps onto the battlefield along with 'the Raging Ironhide.'

name: Executor the Ex Foedere
description: Cannot be healed by allies; Attacks deal AOE Damage; Recovers 50 HP for every enemy hit during attacks, up to Block count
usage: Saint Federico Giallo, known here as Executor.

name: Exusiai
description: Attacks aerial enemies first
usage: Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.

name: Exusiai the New Covenant
description: Continually loses HP over time
usage: Exusiai is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution. She has provided communications and armed escort services to Rhodes Island during the contract period. At her request, her registration has been updated to reflect her current status as a veteran employee of Penguin Logistics and owner-founder of Apple Pie Logistics in Laterano.

name: Eyjafjalla
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Eyjafjalla, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, has wanted to devote herself to doing something for you.

name: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska
description: Restores the HP of allied units and recovers Elemental Damage by 50% of ATK (can recover Elemental Damage of unhurt allied units)
usage: Volcanologist Eyjafjalla, scaling the alp we know as Life.

name: Fartooth
description: Prioritizes attacking the enemy with lowest DEF within range first
usage: 'Fartooth' Knight Justyna will not miss.

name: Fiammetta
description: Deals AOE Physical damage
usage: Fiammetta, senior special correspondent of the Laterano Notarial Hall, will persevere to the end once a goal has been set.

name: Flametail
description: Blocks 2 enemies
usage: Flametail Knight Sona, shooting through the battlefield like fire.

name: Gavial the Invincible
description: Attacks all blocked enemies
usage: The Gavial you know and love. (Toting a battleaxe.)

name: Gladiia
description: Can Shift enemies by using skills Can be deployed on Ranged Tiles
usage: Rhodes Island Ægir Affairs Officer-in-Charge Gladiia, now inclined to divulge some information to you.

name: Gnosis
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Former Karlan Trade Chief Technical Officer, not interested in a single thing beyond technology.

name: Goldenglow
description: Controls a Drone to deal Arts damage to an enemy; When the Drone continuously attacks the same enemy, its damage will increase (up to 110% of the operator's ATK)
usage: Hairdresser and new Caster Goldenglow, tormented by the cycle of shocking and getting shocked.

name: Haruka
description: Deals Arts damage; When skill is active, attacks instead restore the HP of allies (heal amount is equal to 75% of ATK)
usage: Haruka, born Haruka Shino, is a well-known entertainer in the Southern Court of Higashi, performing under the stage name Momoka Hanyuu. She was recommended to Rhodes Island by Operator Hoshiguma and acts as liaison between Rhodes Island and Higashi. She is being assigned to a number of field missions at her own request.

name: Hellagur
description: Can't be healed by other units. Recovers {value} self HP every time this operator attacks an enemy
usage: Hellagur, the visionary Azazel Guard, is joining you to help you achieve your goals.

name: Ho'olheyak
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Caster Operator Ho'olheyak walks the long, winding path of history.

name: Hoederer
description: Attacks all blocked enemies
usage: Sarkaz mercenary Hoederer, the man who approaches, cloaked in war.

name: Horn
description: When not blocking enemies, prioritizes dealing ranged AoE Physical damage
usage: Horn, Soldier of Victoria, here with you to face the crisis.

name: Hoshiguma
description: Blocks 3 enemies
usage: Hoshiguma, member of the Special Service of Lungmen Guard Department, is awaiting your orders.

name: Hoshiguma the Breacher
description: Normal attacks deal Arts damage while the skill is active
usage:
Hoshiguma, chief of the L.G.D. Special Inspection Unit. She remains a defender operator of Rhodes Island, with no change in her main role.
The extent of her combat experience has been amended in her records after she told the Doctor about her early days in Higashi and gave permission for some parts of it to be communicated to us.

name: Ifrit
description: Deals AOE Arts damage in a long line
usage: Ifrit, former test subject of Rhine Lab, will incinerate all of Silence's enemies.

name: Ines
description: Has reduced Redeployment Time, can use ranged attacks
usage: Ines's past is unimportant. Anyway, she wishes to say, 'It's been a while.'

name: Irene
description: Normal attacks deal damage twice
usage: Inquisition Messenger Irene, fighting to protect Iberia's coastline.

name: Jessica the Liberated
description: Blocks 3 enemies and attacks from long range.
usage: Defender Operator Jessica, currently serving as sheriff of a li'l ol' Pioneer camp.

name: Kal'tsit
description: Restores the HP of allies
usage: Rhodes Island Medical Department Officer-in-Charge, Kal'tsit.

name: Kal'tsit Esperanta
description: Restores the HP of allies, and can Take Off
usage: Kal'tsit, one of the founders of Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, also serves as the head of Medical. She has led many of Rhodes Island's large-scale strategic operations and overseen its external communications, making significant contributions to Rhodes Island's operations, growth, and Oripathy research. At present, she mainly participates in Rhodes Island's Oripathy medication projects as a medical expert.

name: Kirin R Yato
description: Significantly reduced Redeployment Time
usage: You rub your eyes to double-check that the woman who stands before you is the operator and friend you haven't seen in ages, Yato.

name: Lappland the Decadenza
description: Controls a Drone that deals Arts damage; When the Drone attacks the same enemy, its damage will increase (up to 110% of the operator's ATK)
usage: Lappland, unemployed. The only daughter of Alberto Saluzzo, patriarch of the Siracusan Famiglia Saluzzo. She is currently separated from her family. Lappland excels in solo combat, and often assists Rhodes Island in tactical Arts assaults and elimination operations.

name: Lee
description: Has reduced Redeployment Time, but DP Cost is not refunded upon retreating; While deployed, 3 DP are consumed every 3 seconds (automatically retreats without sufficient DP)
usage: Lungmen private investigator Lee, open to requests for help no, matter the trouble or challenge.

name: Leizi the Thunderbringer
description: Normally does not attack and has 0 Block; When skill is inactive, ATK gradually increases up to +200% over 40 seconds. ATK is reset when the skill ends
usage: Lin Qingyan, former deputy minister at Yan's Judicial Review Office. She returned to the Tianshi Bureaus to study Lei Fa after resigning from her post, stopping at Rhodes Island during her journeys and taking part in some field missions.

name: Lemuen
description: Prioritizes attacking the enemy with lowest DEF within range first
usage:
Lemuen is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution. She is currently a cardinal of the Lateran Curia's Seventh Tribunal.
While Lemuen claims to be visiting Rhodes Island as the family of an operator, her presence here must be treated as an official visit by a representative of Laterano. During her visit, she will provide us assistance in accordance with our agreement.

name: Lessing
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: Guard operator Lessing, standing in silence.

name: Lin
description: Normally does not attack, but has greatly increased DEF and RES; When skill is active, attacks deal AoE Arts damage
usage: The mystery character from Lungmen, helping you amidst the shadows.

name: Ling
description: Deals Arts damage Can use Summons in battles
usage: Ling, poet from Yan, unchecked and unbridled, content as she wishes. As long as she has wine, anything can go into her poems.

name: Logos
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Rhodes Island Elite Operator Logos, ferryman of the Sarkaz's myriad souls.

name: Lumen
description: Has a large healing range, but the healing amount on farther targets is reduced to {heal_scale:0%}
usage: Lumen, chapel caregiver of Gran Faro, here to soothe your wounds.

name: Magallan
description: Deals Arts damage Can use Summons in battles
usage: Magallan, the Commissioner of Rhine Labs, is glad to welcome new adventures.

name: Mantra
description: Attacks deal Arts damage, and can inflict Elemental Damage
usage:
Elite operator Mantra first joined Babel at Kal'tsit's invitation. She fought in the Kazdel Civil War and became one of Rhodes Island's first elite operators after the war.
Long-time leader of the 3rd Special Operations Squad, Mantra's ability to help operators coordinate when radio communications are difficult or inadvisable makes her an indispensable part of many missions.

name: Marcille
description: Deals AOE Arts damage
usage:
Marcille, the mage of Laios's party.
She claims to have unexpectedly arrived on Terra while trying to rescue her friend Falin in a dungeon. Now on Rhodes Island seeking a way home while providing medical and magic assistance.

name: Mizuki
description: Deals Damage to all targets within range 50% chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks and is less likely to be targeted by enemies
usage: Landship observation target Mizuki, latent threat principally confirmed low at the present stage.

name: Mon3tr
description: Restores HP of allies, bouncing between 3 allies. Healing reduced by 25% per bounce.
usage: Mon3tr is profoundly knowledgeable in life sciences, Oripathy treatment, history and genealogy, and many other fields. She also possesses plentiful experience in mobile combat maneuvers, and offers much-needed assistance during Rhodes Island's rebuilding. Currently serves as a special consultant for the Medical, Engineering, and Field Operations departments.

name: Mostima
description: Deals AOE Arts damage
usage: Mostima, Senior Messenger, will lay low all obstacles in your path with her Arts.

name: Mountain
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: The unchained jail tiger himself, Mountain, immovable as his name.

name: Mudrock
description: Cannot be healed by allies
usage: Mudrock, Sarkaz mercenary, old friend of the fertile soil and stone.

name: Muelsyse
description: This unit can designate one Tactical Point within attack range to call Reinforcements; ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements
usage: Muelsyse, Rhine Lab Collaborating Operator. A strange, peculiar ecologist.

name: Młynar
description: Normally does not attack and has 0 Block; When skill is inactive, ATK gradually increases up to +{atk:0%} over {max_stack_cnt} seconds. ATK is reset when the skill ends
usage: A wanderer from a Kazimierzian knight family, Młynar, with his sword always resting by his side.

name: Narantuya
description: Can only attack while holding a boomerang projectile (projectile takes time to return)
usage: Narantuya, a former desert bandit who once traveled across most of Sargon's lands, now stationed long-term on Rhodes Island as a field operator. With her survival techniques and rich knowledge of the natural world, she happily takes part in missions out in the wilds.

name: Nasti
description: Blocks 2 enemies; Can use <Support Devices> in battles
usage: Nasti Lunorey, director of Rhine Lab's Engineering Section and one of Columbia's foremost authorities in engineering, as well as an expert in applied linguistics. With a reference from Saria, she has entered into a long-term memorandum of cooperation with Rhodes Island and provides support for various projects as a special consultant to the Engineering Department.

name: Nearl the Radiant Knight
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: Nearl the Radiant Knight, draped in the burning sun, her step breaking mist, returns from Kazimierz to your side.

name: Necrass
description: Deals Arts damage; Can create Summons by defeating enemies, and can attack enemies blocked by these Summons
usage:
Necrass, real name Eblana Dublinn, is the former Leader of Dublinn, an organization that no longer exists. After careful consideration, Rhodes Island has conditionally agreed to establish a degree of cooperation with her.
After joint confirmation from the Medical and HR Departments, as well as the Doctor, all of Necrass's files have been moved to the high-clearance database.

name: Nian
description: Blocks 3 enemies
usage: Nian, a mysterious visitor from the faraway land of Yan, is willing to provide a little bit of assistance.

name: Nightingale
description: Restores the HP of 3 allies simultaneously
usage: Nightingale, Sarkaz healer, will do everything she can to provide medical care for the squad.

name: Nymph
description: Attacks deal Arts damage, and can inflict Elemental Damage
usage:
Nymph is a citizen of Kazdel who joined the Field Operations Department through Rhodes Island's Kazdel office.
Her skills with mental Originium Arts and her natural gifts as a Djall have a wide range of applications.

name: Pallas
description: Can attack enemies from range; When attacking enemies not blocked by self, increase ATK to 120%
usage: Priestess Pallas, come from Minos.

name: Passenger
description: Attacks deal Arts damage and jump between 3 enemies. Each jump deals 15% less damage and inflicts a brief Slow
usage: Engineering Operator Passenger, thunderous punisher of enemies.

name: Penance
description: Cannot be healed by allies
usage: A former Siracusan city judge, hoping to do right by law and justice.

name: Pepe
description: Attacks deal 50% ATK as AOE Physical damage to enemies around the target.
usage: Pepe, a renowned historian from Sargon with many tales of derring-do, is also the eldest daughter of a respected padishah. Now aiding Rhodes Island on a series of archaeological surveys in Sargon as a field operator.

name: Phantom
description: Significantly reduced Redeployment Time
usage: Phantom, Rhodes Island Operator, melts into the night like a shadow.

name: Pozëmka
description: High accuracy point-blank shot
usage: Sniper Operator Pozëmka, the one who cherished Zeruertza most of all Zeruertzans.

name: Pramanix the Prerita
description: Normally does not attack, but has greatly increased DEF and RES; When skill is active, attacks deal AoE Arts damage
usage: Pramanix, native of Kjerag and the Saintess of Karlan. She is the religious leader of Kjerag and plays an important role in its development and transformation. She is currently at work developing a basic education system in her homeland. Some reports claim that she successfully dispelled a looming Catastrophe in Kjerag.

name: Qiubai
description: Can launch Ranged Attacks that deal 80% of normal ATK
usage: Swordswoman Qiubai, traveler of the jianghu of Yan, setting her foot down where injustice is concerned.

name: Raidian
description:
Deals Arts damage
Can use Summons in battles
usage: Elite Operator Raidian previously worked on communications support for Babel, and led the establishment of Rhodes Island's communications system, providing the necessary framework support.

name: Ray
description: Attacks consume Ammo to increase ATK to 120%; While not attacking, Ammo will be slowly reloaded (max capacity 8).
usage: Sniper Operator Ray, staring out the window without a word.

name: Reed the Flame Shadow
description: Attacks deal Arts damage and heal the HP of an ally within Attack Range for 50% of the damage dealt
usage: From a mired land returns Reed, a warm flame in her grasp.

name: Rosa
description: Attacks the heaviest enemy first
usage: Rosa, a member of the Ursus Student Self-Governing Group, is ready to welcome a new life.

name: Rosmontis
description: Attacks deal two instances of Physical damage to ground enemies in a small area (The second instance is a shockwave that has half the normal ATK)
usage: Rosmontis, Rhodes Island Elite Operator, pushes open your office door by hand.

name: Saga
description: Blocks 2 enemies
usage: The wandering monk, Saga, joins in on the action wherever she goes.

name: Saileach
description: Cannot block enemies during the skill duration
usage: Standard-bearer Saileach has come to Rhodes Island from County Hillock.

name: Sankta Miksaparato
description: Blocks 3 enemies and attacks from long range.
usage:
Patrizion is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, and the longest-tenured active gun-knight of Laterano. He is intimately familiar with the use of various types of firearms.
In accordance with the memorandum of cooperation between the Lateran Curia and Rhodes Island, he is currently stationed on Rhodes Island as a collaborating operator under the code name Sankta Miksaparato.

name: Saria
description: Can heal allies by using skill(s)
usage: Saria, former researcher of Rhine Lab, will serve as a core part of the squad's defense and healing unit on the battlefield.

name: Schwarz
description: High accuracy point-blank shot
usage: Schwarz, Operator of Rhodes Island, will protect you from the shadows.

name: Shining
description: Restores the HP of allies
usage: Shining, Sarkaz healer, will do everything she can to provide medical care for the squad.

name: Shu
description: Can heal allies by using skill(s)
usage: Nongye Tianshi Shu of Yan, ever happy to impart all the agricultural knowledge there is.

name: Siege
description: Blocks 2 enemies
usage: Siege, leader of the Glasgow Gang, will carve a path for you.

name: Silence the Paradigmatic
description: Deals Arts damage; When skill is active, attacks instead restore the HP of allies (heal amount is equal to 75% of ATK)
usage: Supporter Operator Silence stands ready to provide everyone sanctuary.

name: SilverAsh
description: Can launch Ranged Attacks that deal 80% of normal ATK
usage: SilverAsh, President of Karlan Trade CO., LTD, has signed the contract with Rhodes Island and is ready to join the field.

name: SilverAsh the Reignfrost
description: Blocks 2 enemies, and can support allies in the Deployment Waiting Zone
usage:
Enciodes Silverash, former chairman of Karlan Trade and current Chief of the Silverash Family. He has unique views on economics, trade, international politics, diplomacy, and strategic planning.
Considering his exceptional status and the complex situation in Kjerag, we should be judicious in our cooperation with him, to avoid unnecessary risk.

name: Skadi
description: Blocks 1 enemy
usage: Skadi, bounty hunter, has come with the tide to drown your enemies.

name: Skadi the Corrupting Heart
description: Does not attack but continuously restores the HP of all allies within range (the HP restored per second is equal to 10% of self ATK). Self is unaffected by Inspiration
usage: Skadi the Corrupting Heart, a visitor familiar yet unbeknownst to you.

name: Specter the Unchained
description: Does not retreat upon receiving lethal damage, instead swaps to a (Substitute has 0 Block). Swaps back to the original after 20 seconds
usage: Specter the Unchained, free from her cage, awake from her madness.

name: Stainless
description: Blocks 2 enemies; Can use in battles
usage: Stainless of the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps, ready to move with you at a moment's notice.

name: Surtr
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Rhodes Island Guard Operator Surtr, a person difficult to approach.

name: Suzuran
description: Deals Arts damage and Slows the target for a short time
usage: Suzuran, Rhodes Island Operator, has nine times the strength, and the fluffiness.

name: Swire the Elegant Wit
description: Has reduced Redeployment Time, but DP Cost is not refunded upon retreating; While deployed, 3 DP are consumed every 3 seconds (automatically retreats without sufficient DP)
usage: Lungmen Guard Department Commissioner Swire, fresh off her holiday in Siesta.

name: Texas the Omertosa
description: Significantly reduced Redeployment Time
usage: Still Texas of Penguin Logistics; she says she's just put some new clothes on.

name: Thorns
description: Can launch Ranged Attacks that deal 80% of normal ATK
usage: Thorns, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, wastes not an ounce of energy, calculating each strike meticulously.

name: Thorns the Lodestar
description: Can throw Alchemical Units to assist in combat
usage: Former Rhodes Island frontline combatant Thorns, now a captain aboard an independent exploration-ship/scientific-vessel/finning-boat/cargo-hauler/pirate-ship. As the captain of the Cuna de Nene, he maintains a cooperative partnership with Rhodes Island. We provide medical and supply services, while he in turn offers us many ocean-related conveniences, as well as the means to contact remote Iberian settlements outside the jurisdiction of the Inquisition.

name: Titi
description: Attacks deal Arts damage and heal the HP of an ally within Attack Range for 50% of the damage dealt
usage: Medjehtiqedti, Curator of Varjavandabad Museum. Only her friends can call her 'Titi'. Currently works with Rhodes Island as a field operator, and strives to repair relations between Sargon and Minos.

name: Togawa Sakiko
description: Can launch Ranged Attacks that deal 80% of normal ATK
usage: Sakiko Togawa is the keyboardist of Ave Mujica. She lodges aboard Rhodes Island together with the rest of the band, and actively takes on tasks of all manner aboard the ship. Her musical training and dignified manner are incontrovertible proof of her excellent upbringing.

name: Tragodia
description: Attacks deal Arts damage, and can inflict Elemental Injury
usage: Previously an independent assassin employed at Rhodes Island as a specialist operator, Operator Phantom had achieved his original goal for joining us by the time he returned from his stint as a Wrankwood actor. After discussion with the Doctor, he has agreed to continue his cooperation with us, providing support for nearby Rhodes Island offices on his travels throughout Terra.

name: Typhon
description: Attacks the heaviest enemy first
usage: Facilitator Typhon of Sami, knower of the rules for the hunters of the permafrost.

name: Ulpianus
description: Attacks all blocked enemies
usage:
Ulpianus, Ægir, former Consul of Ægir's Academy of Technology, lead researcher of the Abyssal Hunter project, and a commander of the Ægir military organization of the same name. When and where he came ashore are both unknown. He provides support when Rhodes Island is involved in ocean-related matters.

All files pertaining to Ulpianus have been moved to the high clearance database.

name: Vigil
description: This unit can designate one Tactical Point within attack range to call Reinforcements; ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements
usage: Leontuzzo, ex-heir to Famiglia Bellone, simply a Siracusan citizen these days.

name: Vina Victoria
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Originally registered at Rhodes Island as the leader of the Glasgow Gang, she later worked alongside us as the leader of the Exemplars during the Londinium War. Now, as the Speaker of Parliament, she maintains our cooperative relationship. Rhodes Island has been supporting Londinium's healthcare system, and Vina Victoria has pledged to broaden our partnership in other areas.

name: Virtuosa
description: Attacks deal Arts damage, and can inflict Elemental Damage
usage: Operator Virtuosa visits Rhodes Island, waiting for the performance to begin.

name: Viviana
description: Deals Arts damage
usage: Guard operator Viviana, once known as the Candle Knight.

name: Viy
description: Attacks deal Arts damage; When unable to find a target, attacks can be stored up and fired all at once (Up to 3 charges)
usage: Scioppa Razin, leader and commander-in-chief of the Ursine Independent Tactics Formation 'Sechin,' and leader of the Volniki. In early 1102, he led his unit out of the jurisdiction of the Ursine military. After the Deity Grypherburg Incident, 'Sechin' became fully independent. Later, through an introduction by a branch office operator, he began making contact with Rhodes Island on behalf of 'Sechin.'

name: Vulpisfoglia
description: Blocks 2 enemies
usage: Ingrid, mother of Operator Suzuran, and former core member of Famiglia Venezia—one of the Dodici Famiglie of Siracusa. A veteran assassin who excels in elimination and raid missions, she has separated herself from her famiglia for various reasons. Now works on the Rhodes Island landship as an operator under the codename Vulpisfoglia.

name: W
description: Deals AOE Physical damage
usage: W, Sarkaz mercenary, is the single most dangerous signal on the battlefield.

name: Wang
description: Can use traps to assist in combat, but traps cannot be placed on tiles already occupied by an enemy
usage: Wang, former military advisor to Yan, now an unemployed weiqi player. Younger brother to Chongyue, and older brother to Nian, Dusk, Ling, etc. He came to Rhodes Island to recuperate at Chongyue's recommendation, and is occasionally consulted on tactical matters.

name: Weedy
description: Can attack all blocked enemies Can be deployed on Ranged Tiles
usage: Weedy, a researcher in Rhodes Island's Bioengineering Department, has set foot on the battlefield after completing her studies.

name: Wiš'adel
description: Attacks deal two instances of Physical damage to ground enemies in a small area (The second instance is a shockwave that has half the normal ATK)
usage: Sarkaz mercenary Wiš'adel, the most dangerous callsign the battlefield knew.
